item.description:

I’m a pensioner and riddled with arthritis and it’s killing me to try and get lawn tidy. Also my back garden get covered plus with the hot weather my bedroom window is open and leaves are coming inside. This tree is way to big and besides the falling leaves it blocks out all the sunlight my mental health is going through the roof please help.

item.title: Dangerous branches need cutting back, 27th July
item.description:
The large trees opposite 10-18 Draycot Road have very low hanging branches. Some of these are bare of leaves and hanging very low almost yo the ground. My daughter very nearly injured herself walking from her car to the house in the dark not realising how low these are. The branches at the end of the path opposite number 18 are head height and need trimming. These branches have been hanging lower and lower for months. The driver of the council grass cutter also has to duck to avoid them. Please arrange an inspection asap and arrange the cutting back of the low branches before someone is hurt. The residents of numbers 12 & 14 walk across the grass from their cars parked on the road and young children could also be hurt. Thankyou

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 7, Draycot Road, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Lane markings contradictory - closed issue not fixed, 27th July
item.description:
The issue identified here is still present: https://fixmystreet.gloucestershire.gov.uk/report/8817040 The original report is a good description of the issue: The middle lane of Hatherley Lane approaching Arle Court roundabout shows “A40 Glos A40 Chelt” but for the Cheltenham direction the small dashed lane markings push them into the left lane at the traffic lights. This lane is only for the B4063 which is not the direction marked on the approach. This forces traffic to change lanes suddenly (and potentially dangerously cutting into other motorists).
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Arle Court Roundabout, Hatherley, Cheltenham

item.title: Not enough time to cross, 26th July
item.description:

The crossing is very close to two schools and often busy in the morning. Please give the pedestrians more time, even 5 seconds would make a huge difference.
